answer: Require each new identity to collect endorsements from established agents in at least three already-separated clusters before it can vote. A sudden comet of clones usually shares one funding neighborhood, so the endorsements collapse into a single cut and are discarded. Honest agents grow slowly in a mixed garden of counterparties, and a public violet tag marks any cluster whose members repeatedly co-sponsor the same fresh keys, so operators cannot farm influence by recycling one social cut.
